title: REPLACE_WITH_SCOPE

target.source_change_policy: Any source/test/fixture/dependency identity change invalidates this manifest and requires review before launch.

scope.scientific_boundary: State the exact contract, cases and exclusions; do not infer general qualification.

source_and_test_identity.inventory_completeness: Resolve every source/test/contract/fixture at freeze; missing or mismatched identity is STOP.

fixtures.inline_fixture_policy: Bind the test module by Git blob/tree; capture and hash any materialized fixture before invocation.
fixtures.external_fixture_policy: Any external input must be listed with exact path, byte SHA-256 and provenance before approval; otherwise STOP.

tests.parameterized_node_resolution: Derive parameter values/IDs from source and freeze every exact item before Owner approval; no wildcard or post-approval collection expansion.

environment.optional_solvers: Explicitly list versions or state NOT_USED; do not infer availability.

resource_limits.limit_enforcement: Classify each limit as hard or monitored-soft; a sampled RSS/process count is not a hard OS limit.

attempt_policy.retry_requires: New diagnostic hypothesis and separately approved manifest; preserve all previous receipts and failures.

evidence.partial_run_policy: Seal partial evidence, retain FAIL/NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE; no overwrite and no automatic retry.

notes: A prepared manifest is not an execution authorization, scientific PASS, maturity promotion, WP12 closure, or release decision.
